summary: Frontend-only testing completed for HORMOscope Pro (Paywall) page at /pro. Logged in as test_pro@test.com via API (sessionless direct login due to landing page UI change where Sign In requires hamburger drawer). Verified all 13 requested CRO-copy, layout, selection, footer, sticky CTA, and navigation requirements. 25/25 functional checks passed.

design_issues.screen: ProPage sticky CTA footer vs BottomNav
issues: CTA gradient container (108px tall, z-[999]) vertically overlaps the floating pill BottomNav (y:778-844) on mobile 430x900. Container spans y:712-820, bleeding ~42px into the nav area. The CTA BUTTON itself (y:728-780) sits just 2px above nav top — visually acceptable but tight. The gradient/container's higher z-index (999 vs nav's z-50) means the #0a0a1a gradient can partially obscure the top of the nav pill. Consider increasing the `bottom-20` offset on the CTA container or reducing py-4 so the gradient fade ends above the bottom nav.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Adjust sticky CTA container so its gradient background does not overlap the BottomNav pill. Current: CTA container is `fixed bottom-20` with py-4 and ~108px height; BottomNav pill sits at `bottom-14` (56px from bottom) with 66px height. Consider `bottom-24` (96px) on the CTA container or shrink its vertical padding so the gradient ends at/above y=bottom-14 + 66px = 122px from bottom.

OPTIONAL: Auth UX note — the landing page no longer has a persistent 'Sign In' button; users must open the hamburger drawer. If desired on mobile, expose Sign In in a visible location for deep-links into /pro from marketing.
critical_code_review_comments: ProPage.js (287 lines) — clean, focused, no DRY violations. All data-testid attributes present for critical elements.
RevenueCat integration works correctly with sandbox key; packages load within 5-7s; price computation (monthly-equivalent, savings %, saved $) derived correctly from amountMicros.
Protected route handling correct — unauthenticated users redirected; isPro users see the 'You're HORMOscope Pro!' state (data-testid='pro-page-active').
No hardcoded URLs; frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via auth context. No MongoDB _id leak concerns (frontend only).
Accessibility nit: feature card icons lack aria-labels; 'Restore Purchases' disabled state has no visible loading spinner — only text change. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (25/25 functional checks passed; 1 minor design issue noted)

test_credentials.note: UI login flow (hamburger → Sign In → modal) is functional but was bypassed using direct POST /api/auth/login and localStorage.setItem('token'/'access_token') for faster, deterministic test setup.

context_for_next_testing_agent: ProPage.js at /pro is fully compliant with the CRO spec. RevenueCat sandbox returns Yearly ($79.99) and Monthly ($9.99) packages reliably (~5s). Login on the new StoryBrand landing page requires clicking the top-right hamburger icon (button containing svg.lucide-menu) and then 'Sign In' in the drawer — direct get_by_role('button', name='Sign In') will NOT find it on mobile since it is inside a closed drawer. Faster alternative: POST /api/auth/login and set localStorage tokens. The only outstanding observation is a minor visual overlap between the sticky CTA gradient container and the floating BottomNav pill on mobile — the CTA button itself is above the nav, but the gradient background bleeds into the nav area.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. Minor layout observation: CTA container uses `fixed bottom-20 py-4 z-[999]` (height ~108px ending at y≈820 on 900h viewport). BottomNav uses `fixed bottom-14` pill (y≈778-844, z-50). The 42px vertical overlap is masked at runtime by the CTA gradient (z-999 > z-50), which can obscure the nav's top edge. Mitigation: increase CTA container `bottom-*` offset to bottom-24/bottom-28 or reduce gradient extent.
